sentences.en: The instant he opened the door, he smelt something burning.
sentences.zh: 他一开门就闻到了烧焦的味道。

sentences.en: The instant I saw him I knew he was angry.
sentences.zh: 我一看见他就知道他生气了。

sentences.en: The instant I saw him, I knew he was ill.
sentences.zh: 我一见到他就知道他病了。

senses.zh: 立即的，即刻的；即食的，速溶的；紧急的，迫切的；当前的，目前的
